integrity: Mathematical proof and executable symbolic checker provided; symbolic finite-parameter tests are corroboration rather than proof of universal MGF bounds.
scientific_limitations: Exact constants only for population sizes 3 through 6; global variational reduction, Kearns--Saul inequality, and Bernoulli Hoeffding lemma are cited prior results. No independent validation; earlier unindexed small-population computations remain possible.
title: Sharp small-population constants for weighted exchangeable Hoeffding inequalities
